LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_KeepsakeOpening:
{1} has brought out a small keepsake. The young ratkin insists it belongs to them, but cannot explain where it came from.
You can ask now or wait until adulthood. Taking it causes a -6 mood penalty until it is returned. Destroying it in front of the child causes a permanent -8 mood penalty.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_KeepsakeCustody: The keepsake has been taken from {1}'s inventory and placed in the colony. Returning it removes the -6 mood penalty. If it is still withheld at adulthood, the child will stop explaining its origins. Destroying it causes a permanent -8 mood penalty.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_KeepsakeOrigin: {1} can now explain the keepsake. It marks a ratkin settlement where they lived before being sold. The settlement's name is a little different each time they say it.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_KeepsakeClaimant:
An adult ratkin has arrived and recognized {1}'s keepsake. The visitor claims to come from that settlement and wants to take its former resident home.
You can let them go together or keep the child here. The visitor does not want to leave empty-handed.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_ClaimOpening:
{1} has recovered from plague and can explain more of their past. The child claims to be an unwanted child of a ratkin kingdom, driven out after falling ill. The names and places fit, but the details are confused.
Recognition grants a title that only the child believes, and +6 mood for 15 days. Denial causes -4 mood for 15 days. You can also ask more questions.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_ClaimDemand:
{1}'s story grows more confused, but the child insists on returning to claim the throne. They want your help contacting people who supposedly remain loyal.
If you agree, a small ratkin group will arrive in a few days to take the child away. Refusal causes -4 mood for 15 days.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_ClaimRetract:
{1} has changed their story. The names and places were things they heard on the road.
The child receives -2 mood for 15 days and stops asking to return.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_ClaimLegacy:
A few ratkin have arrived, claiming to be {1}'s former loyalists. They intend to take the child back to claim the throne.
Hand the child over and they will leave together. Keep the child here and the group will bear a grudge, returning later with grain and knives.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_ItemUnavailable: The keepsake is no longer on this map or has been destroyed.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_ApproveReturn: Agree to send the child back
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_RefuseReturn: Refuse to send the child back
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_EarlyAnswer: {0} keeps insisting the keepsake belongs to them, but cannot name its former owner. It remains in their inventory. You can ask again at adulthood.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_KeepsakeWithheld: {0} has reached adulthood and still remembers the confiscated keepsake, but will no longer explain its origins. Returning it can still remove the -6 mood penalty.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_KeepsakeDestroyed: {0} has seen the keepsake destroyed. The -6 penalty for confiscation has been replaced by a permanent -8 mood penalty.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_NobodyCame: No ratkin came to claim {0}. The keepsake stays in their inventory, and they stop mentioning the settlement.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_KeptAfterClaim: You have decided to keep {0}. The claimant is angry and intends to leave after a few insults. Other ratkin may also call the child unsold stock.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_Recognized: {0} has received a title that only they believe. They will mention their identity to other ratkin. Mood +6 for 15 days.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_LegacyRefused: You have kept {0} here. The little group has left, but they remember the refusal.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_RevengeArrived: The ratkin have returned with grain and knives to settle the refusal to hand over {0}. They are attacking the colony.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_GroupScattered: The group that came for {0} has been scattered. The child stays and still believes the throne belongs to them. Mood +8 for 15 days. No further claimants will come.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_KilledScared: Your people killed a ratkin who came to claim {0}. The child is frightened and stops talking about it. Mood -6 for 15 days.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_KilledRelieved: Your people killed the ratkin who came to claim {0}. They believe the visitor meant to capture them and feel relieved. Mood +4 for 15 days.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_KilledViolent: Your people killed a ratkin who came to claim {0}. Looking at the body, the child decides this might also be a way to reclaim the throne. Mood +4 for 15 days.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_SellingMention: {1} has called {0} unsold stock to their face.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaim_TitleMention: {0} has told {1} about their title. The listener does not believe it.
